The number is the lcsc_pn that Raspberry Pi's board RPI-RP2350A-MINIMAL_R4-S1 carries on J2 and J3 ; height: 8.38 mm, the tip of the post above the board: Samtec catalog page F-226 'THROUGH-HOLE .025" SQ POST HEADER, (2.54 mm) .100" PITCH, TSW/HTSW SERIES' (https://suddendocs.samtec.com/catalog_english/tsw_th.pdf, linked from https://www.samtec.com/products/tsw-118-07-l-d, SHA-256 3a5770b11668f4e5a11ba9ceeb4817a23f467b8507e3592f55fb6bd8f96e71bc, read 2026-11-13), page 1, STRAIGHT PIN VERSIONS table, lead style -07: A (10.92) .430 overall, B (2.54) .100 the tail below the body, C (5.84) .230 the post above it, so A - B = .330 in = 8.382 mm (the body is A - B - C = .100 in; the product page says '.230in Post, .430in OAL'); the page prints no tolerance, so none is added.
